description: Read-only introspection of the local-blue-green router's current state. Plugin-namespace registration backing the service-interface verb service_interface::local_self_deployment_service::swap_status. Returns the router's status() payload (active_color, known colors, color → bridge_port mappings, drain entries with timestamps) plus the plugin's own swap-in-progress state. No side effects. Operator-invocable for diagnostic / pre-restart checks.
embedding_description: Read local blue-green router state — which color is active, registered colors + bridge ports, drain entries (color → drain_until_timestamp) for colors winding down, plugin's swap_in_progress flag. Read-only diagnostic; used by operators before restart_with_manifest, by complete_swap to confirm registration, by swap_rollback to determine rollback window. No side effects.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: active_color, known colors, color → bridge_port map, drain entries, swap_in_progress flag.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with active_color. Surface drain entries if any (operator may be in a swap window). Surface swap_in_progress=true if mid-cycle. Otherwise terse: just the active_color + registered colors.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: router_unavailable: ~/.ananta/runtime/<name>.router.sock not present or unreachable. router_status_unparseable: router responded but the payload was malformed (platform bug).
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: If router is unavailable, install via plugins/macos_self_deployment_plugin/src/macos_self_deployment_plugin/blue_green_router/install_router.py and retry. Read-only verb: safe to retry.
